Immediate: Airspace / airports CLOSED across Iran, Israel, Iraq, Syria, Lebanon, Jordan.

  • Flight picture: Recent scans show 326 aircraft (0 military) then later 722 aircraft with 3 military (RCH457, C130, RCH256) — increased military air presence.

  • Trump announced a SECOND 10-day pause on Iran energy strikes (deadline Apr 6, 2026, 20:00 ET). He cites an "Iranian Government request"; Iran denies direct talks.

Military & strikes

  • Northern border: Hezbollah active daily with ongoing cross-border fire and targeting risk.
  • West Bank: Settler attacks intensifying; reports of assaults on activists and water infrastructure.
  • Germany expands Arrow 3 missile-defense with a second site — concrete allied defense deployment.

Domestic / Regional

  • Iran holding week-long funeral ceremonies for the slain Supreme Leader; mass pilgrimages in Tehran — potential for internal mobilization and hardened rhetoric.
  • Economic ripple: Britain’s services sector contracts sharply under strain from the Iran war (PMI, Reuters).

🟢 Good News

  • Pause still in effect now. Germany added operational missile defense support. US warnings to Israel show risk-control measures are being used.

Bottom line:

  • Threat assessment: Escalating.

Situation Report — Day 27

  • Ceasefire/pause: U.S. announced a SECOND pause on strikes on Iranian energy infrastructure — 10 days until Apr 6, 2026 8PM ET. Iran denies direct talks. Pakistan mediating.
  • Pause credibility: First 5‑day pause (Mar 23) was violated hours later by US/Israeli strikes on Isfahan and Khorramshahr. Risk of repeat violations high.
  • Ongoing strikes: US/Israeli airstrikes on Iranian targets continue. Iranian missile/rocket counterstrikes against Israel continue daily.
  • Northern Border (Hezbollah): Daily Hezbollah launches and IDF shelling. Recent IDF response followed clash that wounded a soldier. Heavy Lebanese civilian toll reported (4,300+ killed since Mar 2).
  • Hormuz / shipping: Iran allows passage for selected partners (Russia, India, China) while blocking other nations. Commercial shipping remains disrupted.
  • Airspace & logistics: Major regional airports closed (Iran, Israel, Iraq, Syria, Lebanon, Jordan). Flight scans show military sorties present but limited.
  • International moves: Germany expands Arrow‑3 missile defense with a second site deployed. Russia delegations (Medvedev) present at Tehran events; grain/logistics talks underway with Russian Railways.
  • Negotiation risk: Multiple US reports say US officials warned Iran that Israel might attempt to assassinate mediators. This undercuts trust and raises blowback risk.
  • Secondary fronts: Houthi activity continues (claims against Saudi aircraft). Israeli settler violence in West Bank rising.
  • 🟢 Good News: Pakistan is mediating formal talks. Germany has added a second Arrow‑3 site to bolster homeland defense.
  • Bottom line: Escalation risk remains high. Situation: escalating.
